nodes.label: Merge Notes: v1 to v2 Migration
skills: Frontmatter Ignored for Teammates
nodes.rationale: Teammates load skills and MCP servers from project/user settings, not agent frontmatter, so v1's skills: list per agent never influenced behaviour; fix moved skill guidance into agent bodies.

nodes.label: permissionMode: Not Applied At Spawn
nodes.rationale: Teammates start with the lead's permission settings; per-teammate modes cannot be set at spawn time, so v1's permission table implied a guarantee that does not exist.

nodes.label: tools: Allowlist Is the One Enforced Restriction
nodes.rationale: v1 gave reviewers permissionMode: plan with no tool restriction, so combined with /review's auto-fix a 'read-only' reviewer could still write; v2 gives every read-only role a tools: list with no Write/Edit.

nodes.label: Browser Daemon Collision Across Agents
nodes.rationale: The gstack browse daemon is one persistent Chromium session; two agents driving it concurrently corrupt session state and produce phantom bugs, so browser ownership is now exclusive to qa-browser-lead.

nodes.label: File-Ownership Map Mechanism
nodes.rationale: v1's CTO agent said 'never let two agents edit the same high-conflict files' with nothing to enforce it; v2 requires the solutions architect to emit a file-ownership map and every implementer to run /freeze <glob> first.
